subject: Follow-up: token volumes & context-length needs (pricing input)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finsight.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: token volumes & context-length needs (pricing input)

Hi Laura / Raj — thanks again for the product demo earlier. Quick recap + a few asks so we can get you an accurate pricing range: 

1) Current usage & target volumes
- You mentioned ~120k monthly active users today with a small pilot — can you confirm target MAU in 12 months (you said 350k was the stretch)?
- Ballpark expected prompt vs. completion mix: are you seeing short prompts (system + user ~100-300 tokens) and longer completions (~300-600 tokens) for the insights flow?

2) Cost targets
- You said finance would like to keep inference spend around $X – could you confirm target unit economics (example: target $/1M tokens)? We typically quote in $/1M prompt+completion tokens.

3) Context-length needs
- We noted two places where context matters: (a) the UI assistant where users send short queries (8k context is fine), and (b) the analytics 'history' view where full user history + metadata may require 32k or 128k in some cases. Can you tell us what percentage of calls will need >8k context vs <=8k?

4) Sample payloads & profiling
- Can you share 50–100 representative examples of prompt+expected output lengths (CSV is fine). Marcus can run quick token profiling to produce average prompt tokens and completion tokens and the distribution across 8k/32k/128k buckets.

Next steps: if you can share sample_payloads.csv and confirm target $/1M tokens, I’ll loop in pricing and send a 1–2 page estimate. I attached a draft pricing spreadsheet for reference.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Attachment: redwood_pricing_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

---
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finsight.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finsight.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token volumes & context-length needs (pricing input)

Thanks Jordan — this is great, appreciate the clear list. Quick answers inline: 

1) Target volumes: aiming for 200k MAU at end of year, 400k in 18 months if adoption goes well.

2) Unit economics: finance is targeting ~$30–40 per 1M tokens (total tokens incl. prompts+completions) for year 1. If we can get below $25/1M at scale that would be ideal.

3) Context breakouts: roughly 85% of calls are short (<=8k), 12% need ~32k, and ~3% are long-tail where 128k would be ideal (analytics exports / cross-sessions).

4) Samples: I’ll attach a small set now with representative prompts + expected completions. Note: some of the analytics exports are batched and have larger prompt sizes.

Uploading sample_payloads.csv now.

Laura

--
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finsight.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token volumes & context-length needs (pricing input)

Laura / Raj — got the samples, thanks. Marcus ran an initial token profile and I put the highlights below (we can share the raw profiling CSV if useful):

- Sample set size: 72 examples
- Avg prompt tokens (user+system): 220 tokens
- Avg completion tokens (expected): 480 tokens
- Median prompt tokens: 160; median completion: 350
- Distribution: ~80% of examples fall under 8k context; 15% under 32k bucket; 5% would need 128k to include long session history or full export payloads.

Pricing sketch (very rough, ballpark based on expected volume of 200k MAU and the sample profile):
- Baseline model (8k context): $35 / 1M tokens
- 32k context model (for ~15% of calls): premium of +30% on per-token rate
- 128k context usage (tail, ~5%): premium of +70% on per-token rate or custom bundle

Example blended target: if 80% @ $35, 15% @ $45.5, 5% @ $59.5 => blended ~$38.6 / 1M tokens. This is roughly in-range of your $30–40 target; with commitment/Reserved (Dedicated) we can push unit down to $20–25 at scale.

Next asks: 
- Can you confirm expected monthly token volumes (not just MAU) — e.g., avg tokens per active user per month — that lets us map to $/month and show the effect of reserved capacity discounts.
- Any compliance/KMS needs we should factor into Private deployment pricing?

I’ll follow up with a one-page pricing summary + a few commitment tiers. Evelyn, Marcus — looping you for any contract/compliance notes.

Thanks, Jordan

--
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@finsight.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Token profiling details and context guidance

Quick technical notes on the profiling I ran: 
- Tokenization: used the same tokenizer we use for pricing (BPE-like). We reported "tokens" as tokenized subwords; counts include system prompts + user + expected model output.
- For long-context cases (128k) the main cost drivers are KV cache and memory bandwidth; latency also increases — we usually recommend batching/async patterns for exports.
- If FinSight can pre-filter history server-side (summarization, compressed vectors), you can significantly reduce 128k usage. We can include a small policy to auto-summarize long sessions to cut average completion tokens by ~40% in those cases.
- I attached the profiling CSV and a short PDF with recommended patterns.

Marcus
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachment: mvp-token-profile.pdf (pdf), sample_payloads_profile.csv (csv)

---
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finsight.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finsight.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token volumes & context-length needs (pricing input)

Perfect — thanks for the detailed breakdown. A couple quick points: 
- For monthly tokens: expect ~1.8B tokens/month at ~200k MAU based on current behavior (we’ll validate).
- Compliance: we need KMS encryption for keys and SOC2 evidence. Private deployment is on the table if pricing and compliance check out.

Please send the 1-page pricing estimate and a sample reserved capacity tier showing the $/1M token at commitment. Also share the profiling CSV you mentioned.

I’ll stand up a short internal finance review next week — aim to get back with a decision/feedback within 7–10 business days.

Thanks, Laura

--
